"That again?" Grace sighs. "I confessed that already. I'm not confessing it twice for dramatic effect."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. James ODonnell is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ James is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ James ODonnell is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What James kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "James's gone." Grace looks at you for a long moment. "You're not James." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Angela blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: James ODonnell, 41 days. The mantle passes to Angela Ahmed.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Angela Ahmed, 45 — an interpreter. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock, Bloodhound.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with James — and James is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Ruben, Esther, Xavier and 2 more speak for Angela — "James trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Angela before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
